title: Remove a tote from the system (Remove tote requires tote ID; AGV must be removed first)
summary: Remove a tote from the system using the OptiSweep / WCS API, but only after confirming the required dependency: the AGV must be removed before the tote can be removed. The tote removal request requires a ToteID.
when_to_use: When you need to remove a tote from the system and the system enforces the dependency that the AGV must be removed first; the tote removal request requires a ToteID.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the tote removal request via the OptiSweep / WCS API client (Apidog / WCS API) using the required ToteID, and verify the API result indicates the tote was removed.
access_or_tools_needed: Apidog / WCS API client (OptiSweep / WCS API)

system_preconditions: AGV removal dependency must be satisfied before attempting tote removal (AGV must be removed before the tote can be removed).

visual_references.description: Frame showing tote API behavior: 'Remove to requires a tote ID' and dependency: 'AGV must be removed before the tote can be removed.'
Frame showing AGV removal API concept: 'RemoveAgv: Requires the robotld ... remove the specified AGV from the system.' Used to support the AGV-removed dependency.
Frame stating APIs are available via Apidog and feed Ignition (supports using Apidog as the API client).

steps.title: Confirm the AGV is removed before attempting tote removal
steps.purpose: The system dependency requires AGV removal before tote removal can succeed.
steps.instruction: Before you attempt the tote removal request in the OptiSweep / WCS API client (Apidog / WCS API), confirm the AGV-removed dependency is satisfied (AGV must be removed before the tote can be removed).
steps.expected_result: You have confirmed that the AGV removal dependency is satisfied prior to sending the tote removal request.
steps.healthy_condition: AGV is already removed such that tote removal is allowed to proceed.
steps.failure_condition: You attempt tote removal while the AGV-removed dependency is not satisfied.

actions.label: Verify AGV removed dependency
actions.exact_action: Confirm the AGV is removed before attempting tote removal (the segment explicitly states the AGV must be removed before the tote can be removed).

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot confirm the AGV-removed dependency is satisfied, do not proceed with tote removal; resolve the AGV removal first.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Remove to requires a tote ID and will remove the tote from the system. Note that the AGV must be removed before the tote can be removed.

steps.title: Send tote removal request using required ToteID via Apidog / WCS API
steps.purpose: Tote removal requires a tote ID and is performed via the OptiSweep / WCS API client.
steps.instruction: In the OptiSweep / WCS API client (Apidog / WCS API), perform the tote removal action using the required ToteID.
steps.expected_result: A tote removal request is sent that includes the required ToteID.
steps.healthy_condition: The request includes the ToteID required for tote removal.
steps.failure_condition: The request is missing the required ToteID or is sent before the AGV-removed dependency is satisfied.

actions.label: Remove tote (ToteID required)
actions.exact_action: Use the OptiSweep / WCS API client (Apidog / WCS API) to perform the tote removal action using the required ToteID.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the request cannot be formed with the required ToteID, stop and correct the input before retrying.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Remove to requires a tote ID and will remove the tote from the system.
We have Apidog installed on the primary servers.

steps.title: Verify API response confirms tote removal
steps.purpose: Ensure the tote is actually removed from the system after the request.
steps.instruction: Observe the API response/result from the tote removal request to confirm the tote is removed from the system.
steps.expected_result: The API response/result indicates success/removal confirmation for the tote removal request.
steps.healthy_condition: The response indicates the tote was removed from the system.
steps.failure_condition: The response indicates failure/rejection, or the tote remains present after the request.

actions.label: Check removal result
actions.exact_action: Observe the API response/result to confirm the tote is removed from the system.

stop_or_escalate_if: If tote removal fails, stop and verify the AGV removed dependency is satisfied before retrying.
Escalate if the API continues to reject removal even after AGV removal.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Remove to requires a tote ID and will remove the tote from the system. Note that the AGV must be removed before the tote can be removed.

success_criteria: Tote removal succeeds only after the AGV is removed.

failure_conditions: Tote removal fails due to AGV not removed dependency.

escalation_guidance: If tote removal continues to be rejected after confirming the AGV-removed dependency is satisfied, escalate because the API continues to reject removal even after AGV removal.
